# House Robber

## Solution

```java
class Solution {
    public int rob(int[] nums) {
        int prev2 = 0, prev1 = 0;
        for (int num : nums) {
            int cur = Math.max(prev1, prev2 + num);
            prev2 = prev1;
            prev1 = cur;
        }
        return prev1;
    }
}
```
